curriculum.title: Grade 8
curriculum.description: Ontario Grade 8 mathematics for YRDSB learners. Worked and guided activities illustrate each expectation; availability does not certify mastery.

children.title: Social-emotional learning skills and the mathematical processes
children.description: These skills are integrated across the other strands, rather than taught only as a separate calculation unit.

children.title: Social-emotional learning skills and the mathematical processes
Manage emotions
children.description: Identify and manage emotions while engaging in mathematics.
children.example: Explain how you feel when a problem is unfamiliar.

children.title: Cope with challenges
children.description: Recognize stress and use strategies for coping with mathematical challenges.
children.example: Pause, try a drawing, or ask a useful question when stuck.

children.title: Persist and stay motivated
children.description: Maintain motivation and perseverance when working through problems.
children.example: Try another strategy after a first attempt does not work.

children.title: Collaborate and communicate
children.description: Build relationships, listen to different mathematical ideas, and communicate respectfully.
children.example: Compare two solution methods with a partner.

children.title: Confidence and self-awareness
children.description: Develop awareness of yourself as a capable mathematics learner.
children.example: Describe a strategy you have improved at using.

children.title: Critical and creative thinking
children.description: Think critically and creatively to support mathematical decisions and problem solving.
children.example: Explain whether an answer is reasonable and find another approach.
